title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 43 ]

items.text: The book the cover of which is red is mine.
This is the man with whom John lives.
This is the cat by which the rat was killed.
There are persons without whom a society can not last very long.
It is true that he is poor but smart.
I think it true that he is poor but smart.
I think it is true that he is stupid and rich.
Who he is is not known to all.
Who he is is not known to anybody.
There was not a girl that was not kind.
He is not such a man as tells a lie.
He has as many books as you have.
I have the same watch as you have.
It is natural that you be disappointed at not passing the exam.
When you are going to do anything, keep it in mind that you should do your best
